name: PiGallery2-Plus
description: PiGallery2 Plus is a performance and metadata focused fork of PiGallery2 for large self-hosted photo and video archives. It keeps the fast directory-first gallery experience while adding smoother infinite browsing, richer Gallery Grabber metadata display, share-link and random-link improvements, activity audit logs, public direct image links, safer video fallback handling, and a more ergonomic lightbox player. Mount your media library read-only for safer public exposure.

paths.name: Paths - Config
paths.description: Persistent PiGallery2 Plus configuration, including config.json and extension configuration.

paths.name: Paths - Database
paths.description: Persistent database folder for PiGallery2 Plus index data, job history, share links and audit data.

paths.name: Paths - Temp and cache
paths.description: Temporary files, thumbnails, transcoding cache and generated assets. Put this on SSD/cache for best performance.

paths.name: Paths - Media library
paths.description: Your photo and video archive. The default mapping is read-only and recommended for public galleries.

ports.name: WebUI - HTTP host port
ports.description: Host port for the PiGallery2 Plus web interface.

variables.name: Core - NODE_ENV
variables.description: Runtime mode. Use production for normal deployments; debug is only for troubleshooting.

variables.name: Sharp Input Pixel Limit
variables.description: Maximum source pixel count accepted by Sharp for thumbnails. 268435456 is about 16384x16384 and avoids Input image exceeds pixel limit errors on large GIF/images.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Optional public base URL, for example https://gallery.example.com. Set this when generating share links or random-image URLs behind a reverse proxy.
